title: eludite.solution.add_project input
description: Add > Existing Project... on the solution or a solution folder (brief 0081): add an existing project file to the open solution (.sln or .slnx), in a solution folder when given. Without project, from the UI, the file dialog asks for it first.

project.description: Path of the project file (.csproj, .vbproj, .fsproj), absolute or relative to the solution folder.

folder.description: A solution folder: its path from the solution root (/src/, /src/tests/) as eludite.solution.tree and the Workspace window name it, or its name when that is unique.
